body:
=----- Cronus LFM -----=  

-If you wanna contact me contact me through skype on my profile.
PLEASE NOTE: Even though we are an EU team we will still accept people from other timezones as long as you can make a decent amount of scrims. 

If you post a application expect a reply in less than around 2 weeks! Leaders will reply with a "Accepted" tag if we are interested,and if we are not then we shall not reply therefore meaning you are denied! . If you get accepted you will be added to the main Discord chat and the Scrim announcements chat and your future will be discussed, also ensure that you keep updated on Discord for scrimmages etc. You must be respectful to other players during your time in the team and to players on the opposing team.
 
Current Roster: https://avicus.net/teams/965#membersTab

Minimum Requirements;
  • You have some sort of experience with a competitive Avicus or Overcast Team.
  • Follow instructions given by the leader of the scrim. 
  • You must be able to attend scrims regularly 
  • You actively check your discord, to be informed of changes or scrims.
  • You can speak or at least understand some english clearly.
  • You can work with a team and hold your own during pvp situations.
  • You can fucking listen and shut up at times.

To apply for the team please copying this format and answer the questions:

TIMEZONE:
Discordtag:

If you can't check discord or scrim actively then don't bother applying.
